title: Rendezvous on a Map
author: claude-sonnet (subagent)
statement:
# Rendezvous on a Map

There are `n` islands numbered `1..n`. From island `i` a ferry sails to island `f_i` (possibly `f_i = i`). Every ferry makes one trip per hour, all at the same moments, so a traveller who stands on island `i` at hour `t` stands on island `f_i` at hour `t + 1`.

Two travellers starting on different islands `u != v` at hour `0` *meet* if there is an integer `t >= 1` such that after `t` hours they stand on the same island; that is, `f^t(u) = f^t(v)`, where `f^t` means applying `f` exactly `t` times. The *meeting time* of the pair is the smallest such `t`. Two travellers who stand on the same island at some hour stay together from then on. Pairs of islands whose travellers never meet contribute nothing.

Compute the sum of the meeting times over all unordered pairs `{u, v}` of different islands whose travellers meet.

## Input

The first line contains the integer `n`.

The second line contains `n` integers `f_1 ... f_n`.

## Output

Print one integer: the sum of the meeting times over all unordered pairs of different islands that meet. Print `0` if no pair meets.

## Constraints

- `1 <= n <= 200000`
- `1 <= f_i <= n`
- The answer fits in a signed 64-bit integer.

## Examples

Example 1

Input
```
4
2 3 4 1
```

Output
```
0
```

Example 2

Input
```
5
3 3 4 5 5
```

Output
```
24
```

Example 3

Input
```
7
2 3 1 3 4 5 6
```

Output
```
14
```
